entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a full-reserve system. You're not depositing your money in a bank. You are your own bank. There's no lending out your money without your knowledge because you are the only one who can access your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin is 'n volle-reserwestelsel. Jy deponeer nie jou geld by 'n bank nie. Jy is jou eie bank. Daar is geen uitlening van jou geld sonder jou medewete nie, want jy is die enigste een wat toegang tot jou geld het.

entries.englishValue: As long as you hold bitcoin in your own wallet — not on an exchange or wrapped in an ETF — bank runs are impossible.
entries.targetTranslation: Solank jy Bitcoin in jou eie beursie hou — nie op 'n beurs of in 'n ETF toegedraai nie — is bankstormlope onmoontlik.

entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you're truly in control of your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Met Bitcoin het jy werklik beheer oor jou geld.

entries.englishValue: Banks lend out your deposits under fractional reserve banking. If too many people withdraw at once, banks can fail. Bitcoin is a full-reserve system — bank runs are impossible.

entries.englishValue: Thousands of businesses couldn't pay their employees. The FDIC stepped in — but that raised a bigger question: is your money actually safe?
entries.targetTranslation: Duisende besighede kon nie hul werknemers betaal nie. Die FDIC het ingegryp — maar dit het 'n groter vraag opgeroep: is jou geld werklik veilig?

entries.englishValue: Banks don't hold your deposits in a vault. They lend your money out and invest it — that's called fractional reserve banking.
entries.targetTranslation: Banke hou nie jou deposito's in 'n kluis nie. Hulle leen jou geld uit en belê dit — dit word fraksionele reserwebankwese genoem.

entries.englishValue: If too many people try to withdraw at the same time, the bank doesn't have enough cash to pay everyone. That's a bank run — and it can cause banks to collapse entirely.
entries.targetTranslation: As te veel mense gelyktydig probeer onttrek, het die bank nie genoeg kontant om almal te betaal nie. Dit is 'n bankstormloop — en dit kan veroorsaak dat banke geheel en al ineenstort.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Om Bitcoin by jou besigheid te aanvaar hoef nie jou rekeningkunde te bemoeilik nie. Hier is die kort weergawe — plus die gereedskap en kundiges om dit pynloos te maak.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: As jy reeds kontant of kaart aanvaar, is dit eenvoudiger as wat dit lyk om Bitcoin by jou besigheidsboeke by te voeg. Jy het twee paaie: skakel elke Bitcoin-betaling outomaties om na dollars op die oomblik wat dit aankom (geen nuwe rekeningkunde nodig nie), of hou sommige as Bitcoin (''n paar ekstra syfers om te volg).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Hierdie gids lei jou deur albei — sodat jy die een kan kies wat by jou besigheid pas en met selfvertroue Bitcoin kan begin aanvaar.

entries.englishValue: The short answers to the questions merchants ask most often before they start accepting Bitcoin — fees, settlement, wallets, chargebacks, cost, and more.
entries.targetTranslation: Die kort antwoorde op die vrae wat handelaars die meeste vra voordat hulle Bitcoin begin aanvaar — fooie, vereffening, beursies, terugvorderings, koste, en meer.

entries.englishValue: Tap any question below to expand the answer. When you're ready to start accepting Bitcoin, the business resources at the bottom of the page will walk you through each step.
entries.targetTranslation: Tik op enige vraag hieronder om die antwoord uit te brei. Wanneer jy gereed is om Bitcoin te begin aanvaar, sal die besigheidshulpbronne aan die onderkant van die bladsy jou deur elke stap lei.

entries.englishValue: Accept Bitcoin at your business for lower fees, instant settlement, no chargebacks, and more customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Aanvaar Bitcoin by jou besigheid vir laer fooie, onmiddellike vereffening, geen terugvorderings nie, en meer kliënte.

entries.englishValue: Accept payments with lower fees, get paid instantly, and reach millions of new customers — with zero contracts and zero hidden costs.
entries.targetTranslation: Aanvaar betalings met laer fooie, word onmiddellik betaal en bereik miljoene nuwe kliënte — met nul kontrakte en nul verborge koste.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin gives your business a faster, cheaper, more private way to get paid. No middlemen. No chargebacks. No contracts. Just money that settles in seconds, directly from your customers to you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin gee jou besigheid 'n vinniger, goedkoper en meer private manier om betaal te word. Geen tussengangers nie. Geen terugvorderings nie. Geen kontrakte nie. Net geld wat in sekondes vereffen word, direk van jou kliënte na jou.

entries.englishValue: Below is the short version of why Bitcoin is good for business — and below that, every resource you need to start accepting it today.
entries.targetTranslation: Hieronder is die kort weergawe van hoekom Bitcoin goed vir besigheid is — en daaronder elke hulpbron wat jy nodig het om dit vandag te begin aanvaar.

entries.englishValue: Everything you need to accept Bitcoin
entries.targetTranslation: Alles wat jy nodig het om Bitcoin te aanvaar

entries.englishValue: Work through these resources at your own pace. Each one is a short, practical guide.
entries.targetTranslation: Werk teen jou eie pas deur hierdie hulpbronne. Elkeen is 'n kort, praktiese gids.

entries.englishValue: We only need a few details to get you listed. Address data is kept only long enough to submit your business to the maps.
entries.targetTranslation: Ons het net 'n paar besonderhede nodig om jou gelys te kry. Adresdata word net lank genoeg gehou om jou besigheid by die kaarte in te dien.

entries.englishValue: List your business for free on BTC Map — the open, worldwide directory of Bitcoin-accepting merchants — so Bitcoiners nearby can find you and spend Bitcoin at your business.
entries.targetTranslation: Lys jou besigheid gratis op BTC Map — die oop, wêreldwye gids van handelaars wat Bitcoin aanvaar — sodat Bitcoin-gebruikers naby jou jou kan vind en Bitcoin by jou besigheid kan spandeer.

entries.englishValue: Get your business on Bitcoin merchant maps
Bitcoiners actively look for places to spend. Getting your business on the map puts you in front of every Bitcoin user searching for somewhere to eat, shop, or stay nearby — at zero cost to you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-gebruikers soek aktief na plekke om te spandeer. Om jou besigheid op die kaart te kry, plaas jou voor elke Bitcoin-gebruiker wat naby soek na 'n plek om te eet, in te koop of te bly — teen nul koste vir jou.

entries.englishValue: Just fill out the short form below and we'll submit your business to BTC Map and other Bitcoin merchant maps for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Vul net die kort vorm hieronder in en ons sal jou besigheid vir jou by BTC Map en ander Bitcoin-handelaarskaarte indien.

entries.englishValue: List your business for free on BTC Map and other Bitcoin merchant maps so Bitcoiners nearby can find you.
entries.targetTranslation: Lys jou besigheid gratis op BTC Map en ander Bitcoin-handelaarskaarte sodat Bitcoin-gebruikers naby jou jou kan vind.

entries.englishValue: Thanks for submitting your business. We'll list you on Bitcoin merchant maps shortly.
entries.targetTranslation: Dankie dat jy jou besigheid ingedien het. Ons sal jou binnekort op Bitcoin-handelaarskaarte lys.

entries.englishValue: Your business will be listed on BTC Map and other Bitcoin merchant directories within 1 to 2 weeks. We review each submission by hand to keep the maps accurate.
entries.targetTranslation: Jou besigheid sal binne 1 tot 2 weke op BTC Map en ander Bitcoin-handelaarsgidse gelys word. Ons hersien elke inskrywing met die hand om die kaarte akkuraat te hou.

entries.englishValue: Once your listing is live, Bitcoiners nearby can find your business and come spend Bitcoin there.
entries.targetTranslation: Sodra jou lysing regstreeks is, kan Bitcoin-gebruikers naby jou besigheid vind en daar Bitcoin kom spandeer.

entries.englishValue: While you wait, take a look at BTC Map to see the growing network of businesses that accept Bitcoin around the world.
entries.targetTranslation: Terwyl jy wag, kyk na BTC Map om die groeiende netwerk van besighede te sien wat Bitcoin regoor die wêreld aanvaar.

entries.englishValue: Print your own 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers in English to let your customers know you accept Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: Druk jou eie 'Bitcoin Accepted Here'-plakkers in Engels om jou kliënte te laat weet dat jy Bitcoin aanvaar.

entries.englishValue: Download English 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' sticker files
Thanks for requesting 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' sticker files in your language.
entries.targetTranslation: Dankie dat jy 'Bitcoin Accepted Here'-plakkerlêers in jou taal versoek het.

entries.englishValue: We'll create and publish your sticker files within 3 to 4 weeks. Once they're ready, you'll be able to download and print them for free from our sticker files page.
entries.targetTranslation: Ons sal jou plakkerlêers binne 3 tot 4 weke skep en publiseer. Sodra hulle gereed is, sal jy dit gratis van ons plakkerlêer-bladsy kan aflaai en druk.

entries.englishValue: Sticker files are released in batches, so it may take a few weeks for your language to go live. Thanks for your patience!
entries.targetTranslation: Plakkerlêers word in groepe vrygestel, so dit kan 'n paar weke duur voordat jou taal regstreeks gaan. Dankie vir jou geduld!

entries.englishValue: You'll receive your free 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers in 2 to 4 weeks, in a plain white envelope with 3 stickers inside.
entries.targetTranslation: Jy sal jou gratis 'Bitcoin Accepted Here'-plakkers binne 2 tot 4 weke ontvang, in 'n gewone wit koevert met 3 plakkers binne.

entries.englishValue: Your stickers are on their way 🎉
If 3 stickers aren't enough for your business, feel free to request another free pack — or order in bulk from the same printer we use.
entries.targetTranslation: As 3 plakkers nie genoeg is vir jou besigheid nie, voel vry om nog 'n gratis pakkie te versoek — of bestel in grootmaat by dieselfde drukker wat ons gebruik.

entries.englishValue: On your front door or window so customers see it before they walk in
entries.targetTranslation: Op jou voordeur of venster sodat kliënte dit sien voordat hulle instap

entries.englishValue: Near your register, POS terminal, or payment area
entries.targetTranslation: Naby jou kasregister, POS-terminaal of betaalarea

entries.englishValue: On menus, price lists, or tip jars
Don't stick them anywhere you don't own or have permission to put them
entries.targetTranslation: Moenie hulle plak op enige plek wat jy nie besit of toestemming het om dit te plaas nie

entries.englishValue: Good places to put your stickers
entries.targetTranslation: Goeie plekke om jou plakkers te sit

entries.englishValue: Let your customers know you accept Bitcoin. Order a free pack of 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers to put up at your business.
entries.targetTranslation: Laat jou kliënte weet dat jy Bitcoin aanvaar. Bestel 'n gratis pakkie 'Bitcoin Accepted Here'-plakkers om by jou besigheid op te plak.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin is only half the job — your customers also need to know that you do. These small 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers are designed to stick on your front door, register, menu, or anywhere else customers will see them before they pay.
entries.targetTranslation: Om Bitcoin te aanvaar is net die helfte van die werk — jou kliënte moet ook weet dat jy dit doen. Hierdie klein 'Bitcoin Accepted Here'-plakkers is ontwerp om op jou voordeur, kasregister, spyskaart of enige ander plek waar kliënte dit sal sien voordat hulle betaal, te plak.

entries.englishValue: We'll mail you a free pack anywhere in the USA or Canada, or you can print your own anywhere in the world.
entries.targetTranslation: Ons sal vir jou 'n gratis pakkie pos enige plek in die VSA of Kanada, of jy kan jou eie druk enige plek in die wêreld.

entries.englishValue: Translation for 'Scan to learn why Bitcoin is good for business.'
entries.targetTranslation: Vertaling vir 'Scan to learn why Bitcoin is good for business.'

entries.englishValue: You can print your own 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers, no matter where you live. Click your language below to download the sticker files and printing instructions.
entries.targetTranslation: Jy kan jou eie 'Bitcoin Accepted Here'-plakkers druk, maak nie saak waar jy woon nie. Klik op jou taal hieronder om die plakkerlêers en drukinstruksies af te laai.

entries.englishValue: Fill out the form below to request 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' sticker files in your local language. We'll let you know once they're ready.
entries.targetTranslation: Vul die vorm hieronder in om 'Bitcoin Accepted Here'-plakkerlêers in jou plaaslike taal te versoek. Ons sal jou laat weet sodra hulle gereed is.
Sien jy nie jou taal nie?

entries.englishValue: We'll ship a free pack to addresses in the USA and Canada. Anywhere else in the world, you can print your own.
entries.targetTranslation: Ons stuur 'n gratis pakkie na adresse in die VSA en Kanada. Enige plek anders in die wêreld kan jy jou eie druk.

entries.englishValue: How would you like to get your stickers?
entries.targetTranslation: Hoe wil jy jou plakkers kry?

entries.englishValue: All Bitcoin wallets are interoperable — pick the one that fits your business. Free, instant settlement, no chargebacks.
entries.targetTranslation: Alle Bitcoin-beursies is interoperabel — kies die een wat by jou besigheid pas. Gratis, onmiddellike vereffening, geen terugvorderings nie.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-beursies is gratis. Kies een wat by jou besigheid pas — in persoon, aanlyn of faktuurgebaseerd — en begin binne minute Bitcoin aanvaar.

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: As jy kliënte faktureer (konsultasie, vryskut, B2B-dienste), gebruik 'n beursie wat rondom fakturering gebou is. Jou kliënt betaal 'n Bitcoin-faktuur in 'n paar klikke.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Beursies vir besighede met meerdere werknemers

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: As jy 'n span het wat betalings by die kasregister neem, kies 'n beursie wat meerdere werknemer-aanmeldings ondersteun — sodat elke werknemer sy eie PIN kry en jy 'n skoon oudit-spoor hou van wie watter betaling geneem het.

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: Verkoop jy op 'n webwerf? Hierdie beursies sluit aan by jou aanlynwinkel en aanvaar Bitcoin van enige kliënt, enige plek in die wêreld — geen terugvorderings nie, geen handelaarsrekening nodig nie.

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: As jy 'n winkel, kafee, ateljee of diens op jou eie bedryf, sal enige van hierdie beursies werk. Kies op grond van of jy betalings in Bitcoin wil hou of deel van elke betaling outomaties na jou plaaslike geldeenheid wil omskakel.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business laat jou toe om Bitcoin- en Lightning-betalings met nul fooie en onmiddellike vereffening te aanvaar. Ondersteun in-persoon-, aanlyn- en faktuurgebaseerde betalings met opsionele outomatiese omskakeling na jou plaaslike geldeenheid.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Laer fooie, meer vir die besigheid

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-betalings slaan die banke en kredietkaartmaatskappye oor wat 2–3% van elke verkoop neem. Die besigheid hou meer van wat jy betaal — wat dikwels beteken beter pryse en beter diens vir jou.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-betalings vereffen in sekondes, direk vanaf jou beursie na die besigheid. Daar is geen wag van dae vir 'n bank om fondse vry te stel nie, en geen duur terugvorderingsdispute nie — sodat die besigheid kan fokus op die bediening van kliënte in plaas daarvan om bedrog te beveg.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Gratis om te aanvaar, oop vir almal

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Daar is geen kontrakte, maandelikse fooie of opstelkoste vir 'n besigheid om Bitcoin te aanvaar nie. En miljoene Bitcoin-gebruikers regoor die wêreld soek aktief na handelaars wat dit aanvaar — wat hierdie besigheid gratis blootstelling aan nuwe kliënte gee.

entries.englishValue: Run a business and want to start accepting Bitcoin?
entries.targetTranslation: Het jy 'n besigheid en wil Bitcoin begin aanvaar?

entries.englishValue: Why Bitcoin is great for this business
entries.targetTranslation: Hoekom Bitcoin fantasties is vir hierdie besigheid

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Om Bitcoin te aanvaar, laat 'n besigheid toe om meer van elke verkoop te behou, onmiddellik betaal te word sonder terugvorderings, en 'n wêreldwye gehoor van Bitcoin-gebruikers te bereik — alles met nul kontrakte en nul maandelikse fooie.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin is nie net nuttig by die kasregister nie — dit is 'n beter vorm van geld wat jou spaargeld, jou privaatheid en jou vryheid om transaksies te doen, beskerm. Hier is 'n vinnige oorsig.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Jy het sopas 'n Bitcoin Accepted Here-plakker geskandeer. Hier is hoekom dit goeie nuus is — vir hierdie besigheid en vir jou.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Die besigheid waar jy is, aanvaar Bitcoin — 'n moderne, oopbron-betalingsnetwerk wat enigeen, enige plek in die wêreld, kan gebruik sonder dat banke of tussengangers 'n snit vat.

entries.englishValue: Flyers are one of the easiest ways to introduce Bitcoin to your community. Download a free printable Bitcoin flyer, print as many copies as you'd like, and post them on community boards, in coffee shops, at meetups, or anywhere else people gather.
entries.targetTranslation: Strooibiljette is een van die maklikste maniere om Bitcoin aan jou gemeenskap bekend te stel. Laai 'n gratis drukbare Bitcoin-strooibiljet af, druk soveel afskrifte as wat jy wil, en plaas hulle op gemeenskapsborde, in koffiewinkels, by byeenkomste, of enige ander plek waar mense bymekaarkom.

entries.englishValue: Each flyer includes a compelling headline and a QR code that sends curious readers to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.
entries.targetTranslation: Elke strooibiljet bevat 'n oortuigende opskrif en 'n QR-kode wat nuuskierige lesers na bitcoin.rocks stuur om meer te leer.

entries.englishValue: Unlike stickers, flyers can be printed on demand from anywhere in the world — all you need is a printer and a few minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Anders as plakkers, kan strooibiljette op aanvraag vanaf enige plek in die wêreld gedruk word — al wat jy nodig het, is 'n drukker en 'n paar minute.

entries.englishValue: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education — and we can't do it alone.
entries.targetTranslation: bitcoin.rocks is 'n gratis, oopbronprojek gelisensieer onder die MIT-lisensie. Ons missie is om Bitcoin-aanneming deur onderwys te versnel — en ons kan dit nie alleen doen nie.

entries.englishValue: Whether you're a developer, designer, writer, or translator, there's a way for you to help. We especially welcome contributors who can translate our content into more languages so more people around the world can learn about Bitcoin in their native tongue.
entries.targetTranslation: Of jy nou 'n ontwikkelaar, ontwerper, skrywer of vertaler is, daar is 'n manier vir jou om te help. Ons verwelkom veral bydraers wat ons inhoud in meer tale kan vertaal sodat meer mense regoor die wêreld in hul moedertaal oor Bitcoin kan leer.

entries.englishValue: Fork the repository, open a pull request, file an issue, or just star the project to show your support. Every contribution helps Bitcoin reach more people.
entries.targetTranslation: Fork die bewaarplek, maak 'n trek-versoek oop, dien 'n kwessie in of gee net 'n ster om jou ondersteuning te toon. Elke bydrae help om Bitcoin meer mense te laat bereik.

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Inflasie beteken dat jou geld jou oor tyd minder koop. Bitcoin is beter geld want dit het nie inflasie nie.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: want dit het 'n maksimum aanbod van 21 miljoen Bitcoin. Niemand kan meer Bitcoin druk nie.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.
entries.targetTranslation: Dollars het 'n onbeperkte aanbod, wat beteken dat meer ten alle tye gedruk kan word.

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Histories het Bitcoin oor tyd koopkrag gewen terwyl die dollar dit verloor het. Baie mense gebruik Bitcoin as hul langtermyn-spaarrekening: geld wat hulle kan laat staan en vir etlike jare kan laat groei.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Sou jy eerder in dollars spaar wat jou oor tyd minder koop? Of in Bitcoin spaar wat jou histories oor tyd meer gekoop het?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin is ook 'n instrument vir vryheid

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Die Bitcoin-netwerk word deur niemand besit nie. Dit word nie deur enige regering of korporasie beheer nie. Dit is ontwerp om jou vryheid te handhaaf en jou geld te beskerm.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Mense regoor die wêreld gebruik reeds Bitcoin om hul vryheid te beskerm — selfs wanneer hul eie regerings geweier het om te help of probeer het om hulle te stop.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Maar dit hoef nie so te wees nie.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Mense wat die afgelope 4 jaar in Bitcoin gespaar het, het die lewe goedkoper sien raak.

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.

entries.targetTranslation: Hierdie onbeperkte aanbod is die grondoorsaak van inflasie. Oor die laaste paar jaar het die totale hoeveelheid dollars in omloop dramaties toegeneem.

Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr-kliënte is gratis toepassings wat jou toelaat om op die Nostr-netwerk te lees en plaas. Almal is interoperabel — jy kan enige tyd van kliënt verander en jou volgelinge en inhoud behou.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr is 'n nuwe gedesentraliseerde protokol om aanlyn te kommunikeer — geen enkele maatskappy beheer dit nie, Bitcoin-zaps is ingebou, en jy kan tussen toepassings beweeg sonder om jou volgelinge te verloor.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr is soortgelyk aan e-pos: niemand besit die protokol nie, enigeen kan 'n toepassing daarbo bou, en jy kan enige toepassing kies wat jy die beste hou. Anders as Twitter of Facebook is daar geen sentrale maatskappy wat jou kan sensureer, deplatform of afgradeer nie.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for online communication — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in natively, and you can move between clients without losing followers.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr is 'n nuwe protokol wat jou toelaat om aanlyn te kommunikeer sonder vrees vir sensuur, deplatformering of afgradering.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.
entries.targetTranslation: Platforms soos Twitter en Facebook word deur 'n enkele maatskappy beheer, maar niemand beheer die Nostr-protokol nie.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr is soortgelyk aan e-pos. Niemand beheer die e-posprotokol nie, en enigeen kan 'n kliënt (soos Gmail, Hotmail, ens.) daarbo bou.

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Niemand beheer ook die Nostr-protokol nie, en enigeen kan 'n kliënt (soos Damus, Amethyst, ens.) daarbo bou.

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: As jy nie van hoe 'n sekere kliënt werk hou nie, kan jy jou Nostr-rekening naatloos na 'n ander kliënt skuif sonder om jou volgelinge of inhoud te verloor.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin is inheems ingebou in die Nostr-protokol. As jy inhoud sien waarvan jy hou, kan jy maklik Bitcoin aan iemand zap as 'n dankie!

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: Op gesentraliseerde platforms soos Twitter en Facebook verdien die gesentraliseerde maatskappy geld uit jou inhoud. Maar op oop protokolle soos Nostr verdien jy geld uit jou inhoud.

entries.englishValue: Each pack has a different set of Bitcoin stickers with QR codes that teach people about Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: Elke pakkie het 'n ander stel Bitcoin-plakkers met QR-kodes wat mense oor Bitcoin leer.

entries.englishValue: We'll ship a free pack to addresses in the USA and Canada. Anywhere else in the world, you can print your own or order in bulk.
entries.targetTranslation: Ons stuur 'n gratis pakkie na adresse in die VSA en Kanada. Enige plek anders in die wêreld kan jy jou eie druk of in grootmaat bestel.

entries.englishValue: How would you like to get your stickers?
entries.targetTranslation: Hoe wil jy jou plakkers kry?

entries.englishValue: A mix of Bitcoin slogans and one-liners designed to spark curiosity in public spaces.
entries.targetTranslation: 'n Mengsel van Bitcoin-slagspreuke en een-reëlers wat ontwerp is om nuuskierigheid in openbare ruimtes te wek.
